about: Neutral test cards for the bridge capabilities (scripts in mechanics/, tests in tests/core/test_bridge.gd and test_fight_rulings.gd). No tribe, no Bramble content.

cards.name: Piler
cards.text: When an adjacent friend attacks, this joins in.

cards.name: Burier
cards.text: Once a turn: put a shop unit in your heap.

cards.name: Tider
cards.text: Has +1 Attack per tide. When this dies, +1 tide for the game.

cards.name: Greeter
cards.text: Friends that join the fight get +1 Attack.

cards.name: Veteran
cards.text: After each fight, earn a medal (2 if this survived) and +1/+1 for each.

cards.name: Berserk
cards.text: While outnumbered: +{amount} Attack. Whenever this attacks outnumbered: +1/+1 for good.

cards.name: Driller
cards.text: At the end of your turn, this slot gets +1/+1.

cards.name: Seeder
cards.text: When this dies, add a copy of it to your heap.

cards.name: Swarm Mother
cards.text: When this dies, summon {count} Sprouts; they wait for room.

cards.name: Plated
cards.text: Takes {amount} less damage from attacks.

cards.name: Officer
cards.text: Order (1): a slot gets +2/+2 and Taunt.

cards.name: Grower
cards.text: Start of Combat: +{amount}/+{amount} for each heap entry.

cards.name: Rooter
cards.text: The first time this dies, spend {cost} heap to return it.

cards.name: Charger
cards.text: Start of Combat: this attacks immediately.

cards.name: Raider
cards.text: Attacks the back row while it has units.

cards.name: Eater
cards.text: When you sell a unit, gain its stats for good; its death effects happen.

cards.name: Dirge
cards.text: Your death effects happen twice.

cards.name: Lender
cards.text: Adjacent units have Taunt.

cards.name: Slot Gift
cards.text: Give a slot +{amount}/+{amount}.

cards.name: Thorny
cards.text: Whenever this is attacked, deal {amount} damage to the attacker.

cards.name: Crier
cards.text: Whenever this attacks, +1 Attack. After this attacks, +1 Health.

cards.name: Slinger
cards.text: Instead of attacking, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.

cards.name: Reservist
cards.text: Reserve.

cards.name: Post
cards.text: Reserve units fill slot {slot} first.

cards.name: Sergeant
cards.text: After a round of deaths, summon a Sprout. Once a fight.

cards.name: Setup
cards.text: Start of Combat (set-up): summon a Sprout.

cards.name: Thornlender
cards.text: Adjacent units have +1 Thorns.

cards.name: Edge
cards.text: In fights, your slots give double Attack.

cards.name: Drillmaster
cards.text: Slot buffs you give are doubled.

cards.name: Captain
cards.text: Whenever a neighbour attacks, summon a Piler.

cards.name: Ace
cards.text: After this kills a unit, gain +1/+1 permanently.

cards.name: Squire
cards.text: In the back row, this isn't counted for Outnumbered.

cards.name: Tilter
cards.text: Start of Combat: attack immediately. It takes no damage.

cards.name: Oak
cards.text: Once a fight, comes back as it stands, at full Health.

cards.name: Pacifist
cards.text: Can't attack.

cards.name: Cutpurse
cards.text: After this kills a unit, gain 1 gold next turn.

cards.name: Watcher
cards.text: Whenever an entry goes into your heap, gain +1 Attack permanently.

cards.name: Mourner
cards.text: Whenever any unit dies, +1 Attack this fight.

cards.name: Welcomer
cards.text: After a friendly unit returns, give it +2/+2.

cards.name: Frenzy
cards.text: Whenever this attacks, it attacks again immediately.

cards.name: Loner
cards.text: Never combines into a golden.

cards.name: Molter
cards.text: Molt: the first time this dies each fight, it returns as a plain copy with 1 Health, then gains +{amount}/+{amount} permanently.

cards.name: Twice-rooted
cards.text: Root and Molt: Root first when the heap can pay.

cards.name: Lender
cards.text: Lends its Attack and Health to the units in front of it.

cards.name: Overrunner
cards.text: Overrun.

cards.name: Plague
cards.text: After a friendly unit dies, counts the deaths so far.

cards.name: Edgewright
cards.text: Start of fight: your slots give double Attack this fight.

cards.name: Arms Master
cards.text: Recruit: Give a unit +{amount} Fury.

cards.name: Furious
cards.text: Fury {amount}.

cards.name: Colonel
cards.text: Units in your hand have Reserve.

cards.name: Corporal
cards.text: Order (1): give the slots in front of this +1/+1.

cards.name: Briar
cards.text: Whenever a unit goes into your heap in a fight, gain +1/+1 permanently.

cards.name: Herald of Gold
cards.text: Thorns {amount}.
